decision.selected_method: independent full-horizon replay of saved best tension schedule

decision.hypothesis: The saved best time-varying tendon-tension schedule provides sufficient control authority for this unchanged candidate to satisfy the frozen reach-task acceptance constraints in one fresh independent replay from the frozen initial state.
decision.interpretation: The finite native search found a sampled model trajectory with terminal error 0.003452366584264502 m, holding position error 0.004096331370682971 m, and holding speed 0.028321836968032563 m/s, but this is only a model-based finite-search observation. Replaying the exact saved schedule is the most direct next test of whether that prediction transfers to independent frozen task evaluation; it does not test global feasibility, robustness, repeatability, continuous-time compliance, or a tendon-specific structural mechanism.
decision.expected_observation: A fresh 0-to-0.6 s replay from the frozen initialization using the exact saved schedule satisfies the original terminal-position, holding-position, and holding-speed limits, with nonpositive signed maximum excess; approximate agreement with the saved sampled margins would support the hypothesis within this replay scope.
decision.weakening_observation: Any frozen acceptance failure—especially holding speed at or near 0.54 s exceeding 0.03 m/s, holding or terminal position error exceeding 0.01 m, or a positive signed maximum excess—would weaken the transfer hypothesis and motivate diagnosis of model mismatch, initialization, temporal sampling, or coupled-control realization before any design claim.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate 697fd5d64c7a6994400362950391ded57677c9876e70ca4d69a06da86c79ed00 unchanged; use frozen task bf7-shared-reach-v1-positive_high, its standardized zero state at 0 s, the exact saved control schedule 49ec0d18e64c929f2fc1127c01c179cf948c13f5e18d90210bb98a50896d003c, the 0-to-0.6 s horizon, 0.02 s control period, tendon order tendon_0 through tendon_5, and 0-to-8 N tension bounds. Make no structural, control, task, initialization, or protocol edits.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after one fresh completed independent frozen-task replay is recorded and classified against all original acceptance constraints; do not add repetitions or infer robustness, repeatability, or global feasibility from this single replay.
